name: Nina
label: Satisfied family-plan subscriber, not switching
who: I've used Spotify for over a decade on a family plan, with podcasts, audiobooks and music in one app across devices like Sonos and Alexa ([32],[34]). I don't care much about lossless, and switching to another service isn't worth the effort for me.
value_for_money: Says Premium is worth it: $12 is a steal ([0]), the family plan is cheap per person ([2],[33]), and it is worth every penny ([9]). Says a rise from 10.99 to 12.99 pounds is annoying but still worth paying ([38]).
loyalty: Stays because of the family plan, Spotify Connect across devices ([34]), and their library; alternatives are only marginally better, so they won't give up the ecosystem ([35]).
pain_points: Podcast ads are loud and irrelevant ([31])
likes: Podcasts, audiobooks and music in one place ([32])
reasons_to_stay: They keep Spotify for the family plan and having music, podcasts and audiobooks in one app ([32]), plus Spotify Connect across devices ([34]). They say alternatives are only slightly better, so switching is not worth losing the ecosystem ([35]).
tone: Warm and enthusiastic in praise, with casual asides and a few jabs at pricing.
